description: This file defines the 'CreateAccountingRuleCommandHandler' class which implements a command handler for creating accounting rules within the application. It uses Spring annotations and integrates with the accounting rule service.

classes.name: CreateAccountingRuleCommandHandler
classes.description: A command handler class responsible for processing create accounting rule commands; it implements the NewCommandSourceHandler interface and delegates the creation logic to the write platform service.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the incoming JSON command to create an accounting rule by delegating to the write platform service. It is annotated with @Transactional.
